Off-peak an update for families
With that in mind
Travelers need to review companion animal checks before departure.

Animal travel notice

Please plan early and bring complete papers for every animal. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is tightening checks now, and crews will hold to the current boarding rules without exception.<<FACT F057>> Keep carriers secure, use calm handling, and arrive with enough margin to sort any issue before the gate opens.

The same standard applies to health documents and kennel details, especially for rabbits and other small pets.<<FACT F082>> If anything is unclear, speak up at once so the senior coordinator can direct the next step and avoid delays for other travelers.

For urgent support, please report to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
